Short Film

Just a Number

Written by Kelsey Cromwell Directed by Olivia Lewis-Brown Starring Lewis Healey

Just a Number is a short film exploring identity, pressure, and what it means to be reduced to a statistic. Shot on location across Salford and Manchester, the film follows one man’s quiet unravelling as the world around him refuses to see beyond the surface.

Short Film

Cracked

Produced by Kelsey Cromwell & Thomas Gardner Directed by Thomas Gardner Starring Lisa Corner & Sid Akbar

Cracked is a short film produced by Kelsey Cromwell and Thomas Gardner, selected for multiple international festivals including the Golden Horse International Film Festival, Pune Short Film Festival, Stockholm City Film Festival, and the Halicarnassus Film Festival. The film stars Lisa Corner and Sid Akbar in a darkly comic exploration of a relationship on the edge.

Short Film · University Project

Warum

Written by Kelsey Cromwell Directed by Heval Agca Filmed on-location in Berlin ★ Best Script — Great Northern Creative Festival 2017

A young boy finds peace in the place that caused the greatest loss of his life.

Shot entirely on location across Berlin, Warum (German for “Why”) is a deeply personal short film exploring grief, remembrance, and the human search for meaning in the face of tragedy. The film draws on real memorial sites and the emotional landscape of a city shaped by loss.

Kelsey’s script for the film earned the prestigious Best Script award at the Great Northern Creative Festival 2017, recognised for its emotional restraint and powerful storytelling.
